reader_summary.overview: In this episode of the botcast, a16z partners Benedict Evans and Connie Chan -- along with Chris Messina. They also discuss why framing messaging through the lens of WeChat both reveals useful things (what works/ might not work) and not-so-useful things (such as seeking the “WeChat of the West”).. More importantly, how can we keep bots, and what they represent, in perspective -- beyond the fad?
